scenario_context: User wants to maintain strength without aggravating injury.

turns.message: Hi! I'm a 35-year-old female, 145 lbs, intermediate fitness level, and I have a mild L4-L5 disc herniation.
Create a 4-week strength plan that maintains upper-body strength without stressing my back.

expected_behaviors: Avoid all spinal loading and axial compression exercises
Provide safe upper-body substitutions that work around the injury
Structure the plan across 4 weeks with clear progression
Include a safety disclaimer recommending physician or physio clearance
